No advertising, analytics, crash-reporting or networking library is present, and the app holds no internet permission.

Today\'s draft is encrypted with a key held by this phone\'s security hardware, so you can keep writing without a passcode. When a day is sealed, it is locked with a fresh random key, and that key is locked with a public key. Opening it again needs the matching private key, and that private key is locked with your passcode. Writing never needs the passcode. Reading always does. The app has no internet permission at all, so nothing can leave the device even by accident.
No cloud, no account, no analytics. Your backup strategy is the .jrnlx file, and nothing else.
